new_learnings.text: Buy gate correctly blocked all entries today: 0/3 major indices green despite 1.55:1 breadth. Breadth/index divergence (small caps up, large caps down) signals stealth rotation out of tech mega-caps into defensive names. Cash is the right position.
new_learnings.mechanism: The 2-of-3-indices-green rule catches days where large-cap index weakness masks breadth. Without this rule, we might enter on misleading breadth signals and get caught in sector rotation drawdowns.

new_learnings.text: 电子化学品Ⅱ entering the bottom 5 sectors (-3.48%) automatically disqualifies 3+ enriched candidates (南大光电, 上海新阳, 金宏气体). Rule 1 (sector-first) is working as designed — catching sector rotation before individual stock damage compounds.
new_learnings.mechanism: Cold sector gravity drags even high-quality individual names. The sector filter prevents fighting the macro flow.

new_learnings.text: 恒逸石化 (000703) is the strongest catalyst play in the pool: H1 profit +2300% YoY, Brunei refinery at full capacity, PE only 24.5, MA distances all within limits (dist_ma5=5.3%, dist_ma10=2.9%). Should be #1 entry candidate when buy gate reopens.
new_learnings.mechanism: Massive earnings inflection from overseas refinery asset is a structural catalyst, not a one-time event. The stock has not run away (MA distances still within limits), providing a clean entry on index recovery.

new_learnings.text: MA-distance filter (Rule 2b) flagged 凯莱英 (dist_ma20=18.1%), 京仪装备 (19.5%), and 骄成超声 (12.9%) — all compelling fundamentally but too extended. Backtesting shows these extension levels have high mean-reversion risk even in strong sectors.
new_learnings.mechanism: When dist_ma20 exceeds 12%, historical pullbacks to MA20 occur within 5-10 days ~70% of the time. Entering at extension = buying high and absorbing the pullback.
